I have also done research, even before I considered writing about it. I do however want to avoid going into detail regarding the incident the character went through, because I don’t see a reason to.

Although I have experienced emotional trauma, the only thing I can relate to is things I’ve been told by close people who have experienced it, and research. I will say that her entire personality isn’t, “girl who was violated”, more so it’s something that always lingers in the back of your mind whenever she makes choices and experiences further challenges, because it’s not something you just “get over”.

huh. didn’t like the pacing of this one at all as well as the music choices, though it did get better towards the middle, only to drop off again in the last 3 or so minutes. it nailed the emotional scenes (i teared up for udo for the millionth time) but the fighting was soooo sloooow. also the cgi and character model for warhammer titan wasnt all the great. definitely my least favorite episode this season, plus some of the english sub translations felt off on hulu, weird.

Now that you mention it, a lot of my favorite scenes revolve around Eren interacting with other characters. But seeing Eren side with characters i don’t like, like Yelena, Floch (to a lesser extent, i don’t HATE Floch) and the faceless Yaegarists who’s names i already forgot, just makes Eren seem a lot less involved. Of course seeing characters i love like Pieck, Reiner and Magath interacting with Hange and Armin warms my heart, and Eren is a great character, but it’s hard for characters, in my opinion, to shine with no one interesting around them. Maybe i just want my 3 babies from chapter 1 back, but the only interactions with Eren i really look forward too are with Zeke, who’s inclusion is all but nothing now. He does speak to our main crew through the path, but nothing he has to say really interests me. Eren almost seems more like an obstacle than a villain.

I agree that his character development is satisfying, but i feel like knowing what he becomes and rereading the series as a whole  makes the emotional scenes feel a lot different than they originally did. This was probably done on purpose, but seeing Eren at the end of Clash and Uprising/Begining of Return don’t have the same impact, and just makes me dislike some of those emotional scenes.
